title: Portal Plugins Manifest
description: Schema for LumeWeb Portal plugin configuration manifest

portalVersion.description: Portal core version to build (semantic version, 'latest', branch name like 'develop', or git hash)

plugins.description: List of plugins to include in the portal build

module.description: Go module path for the plugin

version.description: Plugin version (semantic version, 'latest', 'develop', or git hash)

setup.description: Inline bash script to run inside the build container before generate/build/test. Use for installing extra dependencies (e.g. Kubo, jq, system packages).
examples:
apt-get update && apt-get install -y jq
wget -q https://github.com/ipfs/kubo/releases/download/v0.34.0/kubo_v0.34.0_linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar -xzf kubo_v0.34.0_linux-amd64.tar.gz && cp kubo/ipfs /usr/local/bin && ipfs init

replacements.description: Go module replacements (equivalent to go.mod replace directives). Used when a plugin requires a forked or patched dependency.

old.description: The Go module path being replaced (with optional @version)

new.description: The replacement Go module path (with optional @version)
